scope: Read-only official API diagnosis; no live authenticated requests, writes, credentials, or application edits.

account.provenance: Parent supplied public identity; adapter must independently bind installation account.

verdict: The documented personal installation-token path is available without OAuth or adding existing repositories. Use established permission keys; do not invent keys for newly displayed permission labels.

sources.finding: POST /user/repos explicitly supports GitHub App installation access tokens. Required alternatives are Administration write or Repository creation write. Fresh direct endpoint read corrects an earlier stale search snippet omitting installation tokens.

In the selected-repositories installation instructions, repositories created by the App receive automatic access. No separate installation repository-access mutation is needed for the normal create path. Documentation does not establish that the UI permits an empty initial selection.

App JWT creates installation tokens. Documented JSON permission keys include administration, contents, metadata. Explicit permissions narrow grants; repository_ids narrows repository access and cannot expand the installation. Omitted repository_ids means all repositories available to that installation. Tokens expire after one hour; do not assume a fixed 40-character format.
Endpoint lists installation tokens and a GitHub App installation repository access write permission. This permission and endpoint are unnecessary for repositories created by this App.

POST /user/repos enabledForGitHubApps=true. app-permissions schema contains administration, contents, metadata; administration explicitly describes repository creation. No corresponding JSON keys for the display labels Repository creation or GitHub App installation repository access were present in app-permissions. This is an unresolved schema/documentation mapping, not proof that those capabilities do not exist.

smallestFlow: Verify App ID, exact installation ID, account User/id/login, unsuspended status and repository_selection selected. Refuse all-personal installation access.
Keep unrelated repositories unselected. Bound and verify selected repository inventory against explicitly authorized broker-owned repositories; do not adopt or mutate an unrelated repository.

Mint creation installation token with explicit permissions administration:write and metadata:read. Persist the existing once-only creation intent, then POST /user/repos with the deterministic new private repository name and ownership marker.

Verify exact returned/reconciled repository ID, owner, private visibility and ownership marker. App-created access is documented automatic; failure to read it does not authorize adding repositories or widening permissions.

Mint each content token with repository_ids:[exact verified new repository ID] and permissions contents:write,metadata:read. Preserve existing exact Git tree/commit/ref reconciliation and unknown-outcome no-replay policy.
constraints: Administration write is broader than creation at the permission level. Repository selection is the boundary that keeps unrelated personal repositories outside this App; do not describe the token as intrinsically create-only.

No initial empty-selection claim. If installation UI needs an initial repository, use an explicitly authorized dedicated new bootstrap repository, never silently select an existing unrelated repository.
Do not guess repository_creation or installation_repository_access JSON names. Existing administration alternative avoids dependence on unknown mappings.
Actual App installation, selected-access behavior, token minting and repository creation remain unexecuted acceptance; this verdict establishes documented implementation eligibility only.
